legend.jpNature.parkAreasScope: National, quasi-national and prefectural natural parks combined; the source has no park names or park types. The three zones are nested (special protection zones lie inside special zones).
legend.jpNature.parkAreasAccuracy: Special and special protection zones are reference-only in the official land use plans and their accuracy is not guaranteed; source years vary by prefecture (2002–2014).
legend.jpNature.okayama: Okayama Prefecture features are non-commercial only (CC BY 4.0 with restriction).
legend.jpNature.nationalParksTitle: National park zoning (Ministry of the Environment, 2025-04)
legend.jpNature.nationalParksScope: 35 national parks; quasi-national and prefectural parks are not covered (see Natural park areas).
legend.jpNature.moeLicense: Terms of use for this Ministry of the Environment GIS data could not be confirmed (data page unreachable; not covered by the Biodiversity Center PDL1.0).
legend.jpNature.wildlifeTitle: National wildlife protection areas (Ministry of the Environment, 2025-04)
legend.jpNature.wildlifeScope: Nationally designated areas only (347, including special protection zones, which show darker where they overlap); prefecture-designated areas are not covered.
legend.jpNature.didDefinition: DID = contiguous census basic unit blocks with about 4,000 people/km² or more, totalling 5,000 people or more (Statistics Bureau definition).
legend.jpNature.didScope: Five censuses 1995–2015; 2020 and pre-1995 are not included.
